dct_description_sm: The Measuring Early Childhood Outside study conducted a national survey on outdoor play provision in Canadian early learning and child care centres. Quantitative survey questions sought to understand the frequency and duration of outdoor play and children's participation in risky play opportunities while in child care. In addition, variables related to staffing, geographic location, outdoor environment and pedagogy were collected. This dataset contains all cross-sectional quantitative survey data, organized by province and territory.
